definitions: A machine learning preprocessing technique used to convert categorical data into numerical data, where the categorical values have an intrinsic order or ranking.
An object or class in a software library (e.g., scikit-learn) that implements the ordinal encoding transformation.
examples: The OrdinalEncoder was applied to the 'education' column.
We initialized an OrdinalEncoder with specific categories.
